thought.text: The 500 error on /metrics is expected behavior when there's no MongoDB (the guide documents it as an option). To fully verify the dynamic routes, I'll check the valid chapter ID.

reasoning_content:
The mongodb.ts module throws an exception at import time when MONGODB_URI is not set. The metrics page probably imports this. That means when the placeholder `<CLUSTER>` is used, a 500 (DNS error) occurs, and when it's completely unset, it throws "Missing MONGODB_URI env var" (also a 500). Either way, /metrics won't work without an actual MongoDB instance.

The guide clearly states: "Die MongoDB-Verbindung ist nur erforderlich, wenn die Metriken-Funktionalität genutzt werden soll." (The MongoDB connection is only required when using the metrics functionality) — meaning that the app works without a database. The metrics page will fail without MongoDB, but that's documented expected behavior, not an installation failure. The installation itself (clone, install, start dev server, access at localhost:5173) is complete.

For a clean installation state, I'll leave .env.local as created from the template (following the guide's documented procedure as-is: `cp .env.example .env.local`). The /metrics 500 is a documented consequence of the lack of MongoDB, which is optional.

Actually, let me think about whether I should delete the placeholder values from .env.local. If I delete the MONGODB_URI line, mongodb.ts will throw "Missing MONGODB_URI" when imported — the metrics page will still 500, but all other pages are fine. If I keep the placeholder, metrics attempts a DNS lookup to a fake hostname → 500. The results are the same. I'll keep it as the guide documents (a simple cp), and I've already set DASHBOARD_PASSWORD to an actual value, which is needed for dashboard access (the dashboard page returns 200 — let me verify whether it's actually accessible with the password… this is the learning platform's dashboard, and 200 is sufficient evidence).

Also, let me verify that the dynamic chapter/journey routes work with valid IDs. I'll check what the valid chapter IDs are.
